llm_summary: Summary: The overall sentiment toward the Cosrx Oil-Free Ultra-Moisturizing Lotion with Birch Sap is highly positive, as users with sensitive, acne-prone, and combination skin frequently rely on it as a staple for its lightweight, non-irritating hydration. While many praise its gentle formula, some users find it insufficient for drier conditions or when paired with harsh actives, noting that it may not provide enough moisture for those seeking a thicker, more intensive barrier cream.
